title: Beyond the Battlefield: Framing Analysis of Media Coverage in Conflict Reporting

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the targets of demonizing and dehumanizing language, as well as the assignment of 'assailant' versus 'victim' semantic roles to specific national and ethno-national groups (e.g., Israelis, Palestinians) across news outlets from the US, UK, and the Middle East using LLMs and frame semantic parsing.

Operationalizing Galtung's war and peace journalism framework through LLM prompting to detect partisan framing, nationalistic framing, adversarial language, and the focus on elite figures versus common people in conflict reporting.
